limitations: Packaged files include tests and possibly unreleased maps.
Buildable entries are serialized scenario configuration; runtime unlocks and menu visibility have not been tested.
Initial prefab instances are entity counts, not guaranteed resource units or independent buildings.
Missing need switches in older layouts remain unspecified; do not interpret missing as false.
Objective labels use metadata enum order, checked against compressed enum constants.
Population/happiness/housing objectives may carry an unused prefab reference; ignore target for those objective types.
